hook: Devgad Ghat par raat do baje, saaya peeche pada tha...
hook_text: Maa ne haath kyun nahi chhoda?
feedback: Great emotional core and twist execution. To make it peak 10/10: 1) Ensure Cut 1 cold-open uses a tight extreme close-up flash of terror before snapping to the wide motif, perfectly matching the required rhythm. 2) Remove text rendered inside the image prompt (Image I7 has readable text 'Aai ka hospital mein nidhan ho gaya'—instead describe the glowing phone UI visually without relying on embedded text rendering, letting narration handle the precise words).
lines: Devgad Ghat par raat do baje, saaya peeche pada tha...
Par Tanmay ko laga wo apni Aai ke saath surakshit hai.
Zoron ki baarish mein Devgad ke sunsaan ghat par aakhri auto chal raha tha.
Paas baethi Aai ne Tanmay ka haath bahut kaskar pakad rakha tha.
Beta, peeche mat dekhna, bas mera haath thaame rakh.
Auto driver sheeshe mein dekhe bina betahaasha gaadi bhaga raha tha.
Tanmay ne mehsoos kiya, Aai ki ungliyan baraf ki tarah thandi thain.
Tabhi sannaate mein Tanmay ke phone ki bell baji.
Mama ka message tha— 'Tanmay, hospital mein Aai ka baarah baje hi nidhan ho gaya.'
Ye... ye kaise ho sakta hai?
Tanmay ne ghabraakar bagal mein dekha, seat bilkul khaali thi!
Bhaiya peeche Devchar tha! Tumhari maa ki saaya hi tumhein bacha rahi thi!
Ghat paar hote hi saaya ojhal ho gaya, par maa ka pyaar amar raha.
Yaad rakhna, Devgad Ghat par raat do baje kabhi peeche mat dekhna...
